issues.description: Field type mismatch for Farm.animals: the Problem Statement (and template instructions) require the farm to maintain a List<Animal> implemented with an ArrayList (constructor should initialize an ArrayList and getter/setter should use List<Animal>). The provided solution instead declares the field as private Queue<Animal> animals and initializes it with new LinkedList<>(), with getter/setter using Queue<Animal>. This is a structural contradiction about the declared collection type for the animals attribute and will confuse students about the expected type and API (List vs Queue) and which concrete implementation to use (ArrayList vs LinkedList).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the collection type consistent between specification/template and solution. Preferred fix: change the solution to use the specified type - declare private List<Animal> animals; initialize it in the no-arg constructor with animals = new ArrayList<>(); and update getter/setter signatures to use List<Animal>. Alternatively, if a Queue/LinkedList is intentionally desired, update the problem statement and template to explicitly accept Queue<Animal> with LinkedList and remove the ArrayList requirement.
